stem.text: Which statement is a possible description of how resistance to penicillin may develop in bacteria?

A.text: A mutation of a bacterial gene prevents penicillin from binding to DNA in bacterial cells, which allows DNA replication to continue.

B.text: A mutation of a bacterial gene causes penicillin to bind less readily to certain proteins, which allows bacteria to continue producing cell walls.

C.text: A mutation of a bacterial gene allows the production of an enzyme that breaks down penicillin, which allows the ribosomes to continue functioning.

D.text: A mutation of a bacterial gene changes the tertiary structure of an enzyme that penicillin inhibits, which allows bacteria to continue producing cell membranes.
